label: class_d_05_language_04
text: Leading up to the midterm, we learned all sorts\nof words from different regions![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_05_language_05

label: class_d_05_language_07
text: As you just heard, Pokémon can also use words\nto communicate![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_05_language_08
text: It’s not always easy for us to understand them,\nbut their words have meaning—just as ours do.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_05_language_09
text: Pokémon can use language to share all kinds of\ninformation with each other—like the location of\r\nfood or whether there may be predators nearby![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_05_language_10
text: The same Pokémon’s cries may sound different\ndepending on what it wants to say![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_05_language_11

label: class_d_05_language_18
text: The same Pokémon can even communicate its\nfeelings in many different ways![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_05_language_19

label: class_d_05_language_20

label: class_d_05_language_21

label: class_d_05_language_22
